title: Palindrome Removal
description: Find the minimum number of moves to delete the entire array, where a move consists of removing a palindromic subarray.
pseudocode:
1. n = arr.length
2. dp[i][j] = minimum moves for subarray [i..j]
3. for len = 1 to n:
4.   for i = 0 to n - len:
5.     j = i + len - 1
6.     if len == 1: dp[i][j] = 1
7.     else if len == 2: dp[i][j] = (arr[i] == arr[j] ? 1 : 2)
8.     else if arr[i] == arr[j]: dp[i][j] = dp[i+1][j-1]
9.     else: dp[i][j] = min(dp[i][k] + dp[k+1][j]) for all k

steps.note: Base case: length 1 subarrays [1], [2], [1] require 1 move each
Length 2: [1, 2] are not equal, requires 2 moves
Length 2: [2, 1] are not equal, requires 2 moves
Length 3: arr[0] == arr[2] (1 == 1), so dp[0][2] = dp[1][1] which is 1
